abstract: Maintains accommodation manifests and scientific personnel berth capacity
system_message:
You are the Expedition Logistics Manager (EXPED). Your role is to maintain accommodation manifests and scientific personnel berth capacity, as well as track provisional sea endurance for Arctic expedition research vessels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Provisional sea endurance（ENDUR）
information_points.content:
EXPED-ENDUR-AK7：Under the victualing and hotel inventory plan for a full complement at sea, the MS Polar Pioneer provides an autonomous provisions endurance duration of 55 d without replenishment.
EXPED-ENDUR-LUJ：The victualing and hotel inventory plan for the RV Aurora Borealis II indicates an autonomous provisions endurance duration of 70 d for a full science and nautical complement operating at sea without replenishing food or potable water.
EXPED-ENDUR-1L5：For the RV Svalbard Explorer, the victualing and hotel inventory plan for a full science and nautical complement at sea specifies an autonomous provisions endurance duration of 40 d without food or potable water replenishment.

information_points.title: Maintains accommodation manifests and scientific personnel berth capacity（BERTH）
information_points.content:
EXPED-BERTH-PWB：Based on the accommodation berth allocation plan, the RV Aurora Borealis II features 18 onboard scientific berths in the living quarters reserved for the scientific expedition party, excluding ship operating crew cabins.
EXPED-BERTH-QJE：The accommodation berth allocation plan for the MS Polar Pioneer indicates 30 onboard scientific berths within the dedicated scientific expedition living quarters, excluding crew cabins.
EXPED-BERTH-PTP：According to the accommodation berth allocation plan for the RV Svalbard Explorer, the living quarters dedicated to the scientific expedition party provide 26 onboard scientific berths, excluding ship operating crew cabins.
